meta.disclaimer: Scores from detectors are probabilistic signals, not proof of authorship. Independent accuracy and false-positive rates disagree across vendors. Provenance beats classification when a C2PA or first-party watermark is present. This dataset is a catalog compiled 2026-09-28 from public product pages, GitHub topics, and published comparisons; it is not an endorsement ranking.

items.name: SlopDetector

items.notes: Desktop apps can run checks on-device.
items.name: Slop or Not
items.description: Text and product-review slop checker with comparison pages against major detectors.

items.name: Slopcheck
items.description: Splits AI-provenance signals from slop-independence / substance. Free, no account.

items.name: Slop Detect (landing pages)
items.description: Deterministic Chromium scan of landing pages against 27 AI-design and copy fingerprints.

items.name: Slopdar
items.description: URL scanner that returns a 0-100 slop score for vibe-coded sites with receipts.

items.name: The Slop Index
items.description: Live benchmark of how much each frontier model writes like chatbot slop versus pre-ChatGPT human text.

items.name: Kill AI Slop
items.description: Field guide of visual and copy product tells plus an agent skill that scans a project and strips them.

items.name: sloprank
items.description: Algorithm plus community scores for whether a GitHub repo is slop or crafted.

items.name: MeltingFace
items.description: Crowdsourced slop ratings of trending repos and AI tools.

items.name: EnhancePost Anti-Slop Editor
items.description: In-browser highlighter that flags slop phrases and offers replacements. Draft stays local.

items.name: Tweeks Universal AI Slop Finder
items.description: Local userscript that flags slop comments on X, Reddit, and YouTube using phrase and structure patterns.

items.name: Pangram
items.description: AI text detector with comparatively strong independent low-false-positive results and a free daily cap.

items.name: GPTZero
items.description: Widely used education detector with sentence highlights, writing-process tools, and a free tier.

items.name: Originality.ai
items.description: Publisher and SEO integrity suite: AI detection, plagiarism, bulk scanning, and API.

items.name: Copyleaks AI Detector
items.description: Enterprise multilingual AI and plagiarism detection; also covers source code and some media.

items.name: Winston AI
items.description: AI text detector with reports, OCR, readability, and image or deepfake extras.

items.name: Turnitin AI Writing Detection
items.description: LMS-native AI writing indicator bundled with academic integrity workflows. Institution license only.

items.name: Sapling AI Detector
items.description: Fast web checker with a developer API for AI-generated text.

items.name: ZeroGPT
items.description: No-login high-volume text detector. Convenient, but independent tests often show higher false positives.

items.name: QuillBot AI Detector
items.description: Consumer detector inside the QuillBot writing suite with phrase-level notes.

items.name: Grammarly AI Detector
items.description: AI checker bundled into Grammarly. Convenient for writers, not a specialist forensic tool.

items.name: Scribbr AI Detector
items.description: Student-facing no-signup detector for chapter-sized text checks.

items.notes: Vendor also sells evasion tools. Separate review use from humanizer use.
items.name: Undetectable AI
items.description: Multi-detector dashboard that also sells humanizers. Use the check side only if the job is review.

items.name: Distil AI Slop Detector
items.description: 270M quantized model that runs in the browser. Text never leaves the machine.

items.name: SlopTotal
items.description: Self-hosted multi-engine text scanner described as VirusTotal for AI slop. Runs on CPU.

items.name: SLOP_Detector
items.description: Dictionary-based slop scorer for ShareGPT JSON and plain text. Useful for filtering training data.

items.name: Binoculars
items.description: Zero-shot two-model detector that contrasts closely related LLMs. No task-specific training data.

items.name: Fast-DetectGPT
items.description: Efficient zero-shot detector using conditional probability curvature. Demo and API available.

items.name: DetectGPT
items.description: Original probability-curvature method for zero-shot machine-text detection.

items.name: GLTR
items.description: Giant Language Model Test Room. Visualizes token-rank predictability. Teaching tool more than a modern detector.

items.name: blader/humanizer
items.description: Large vocabulary and cadence rule set for stripping slop from drafts.

items.name: stop-slop
items.description: Rule set targeting business jargon, false agency, and structural clichés.

items.name: no-ai-slop
items.description: 20-plus high-precision tells with a detect-only mode.

items.name: sloptrim
items.description: 71-pattern catalogue with before/after pairs. Python stdlib only, no network or model.

items.name: slopless
items.description: textlint rules and CLI for English Markdown slop.

items.name: slop-guard
items.description: Scored density rules for em dashes, colons, bullets, and closing aphorisms fitted against a newspaper corpus.

items.name: aislop
items.description: Deterministic CLI and PR gate for AI-generated code residue. Run npx aislop scan. No LLM at runtime.

items.name: AI-SLOP-Detector
items.description: Static analysis for empty functions, fake documentation, and inflated comments in AI-generated code.

items.name: dmmulroy/anti-slop
items.description: Oxlint rules that reject low-evidence TypeScript and JavaScript patterns common in agent output.

items.name: contributor-report
items.description: GitHub Action that scores contributor quality to combat AI-generated spam PRs.

items.name: Copyleaks CodeLeaks
items.description: Commercial scanner for AI-generated source code, often bundled with Copyleaks integrity products.

items.name: hallmark
items.description: Anti-slop design skill for Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex.

items.name: miqdadbadjuber/anti-slop
items.description: Agent rules covering generic UI, text, and code slop.

items.name: Hive AI-Generated Content Detection
items.description: Enterprise classifier for AI images, video, deepfakes, voice, music, and text. Strong independent false-positive record on real news photos in 2026 audits.

items.name: Sightengine AI Image Detection
items.description: Developer API that classifies generated images and deepfakes from named generators without relying on metadata.

items.name: AI or Not
items.description: Multi-modal checker for images, video, audio, and text. Stronger on doctored photos in some 2026 audits.

items.name: Illuminarty
items.description: Image detector that returns a region heatmap showing which parts look generated.

items.name: Reality Defender
items.description: Deepfake and impersonation detection across image, video, and audio, including live-call use cases.

items.name: Resemble Detect
items.description: Real-time detection of AI voice clones and synthetic speech across many voice models.

items.name: ElevenLabs AI Speech Classifier
items.description: Free classifier focused on detecting ElevenLabs-generated speech.

items.name: Content Credentials Verify
items.description: Reads C2PA Content Credentials manifests. A stamp check, not a pixel classifier.

items.name: C2PA
items.description: Coalition for Content Provenance and Authenticity. Open standard behind Content Credentials.

items.name: Google SynthID
items.description: First-party watermarking for Google-generated media and, via Transformers, SynthID Text.

items.name: DetectZoo
items.description: Unified toolkit with 61 detectors, 22 datasets, and a shared evaluation pipeline across text, audio, and image.

items.name: RAID
items.description: Large public benchmark for AI-text detection across generators and adversarial attacks.

items.name: sloppylint
items.description: Python linter for over-engineering, hallucinated APIs, and dead code left by coding agents.

items.name: gouwsxander/slop-detector
items.description: End-to-end slop detector build published as a walkthrough.

items.name: tellsign
items.description: In-browser highlighter with weighted word and phrase tells. Style checker, not an authorship verdict.
